description_en: This operation cancels calls from a call task. You cannot cancel a call if its detail record is already in the pending call queue or is in progress
description_zh: 呼叫任务取消呼叫，如明细记录已经进入待呼队列或者正在呼叫，则无法取消
name: CancelAiCallDetails

parameters.help_en: The task ID. You can view the task ID on the Call Task Management page or obtain it by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926799.html operation
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID。在呼叫任务管理界面查看任务ID或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926799.html接口获取任务ID
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: A list of detail IDs. If you specify this parameter, `BatchId` and `PhoneNumbers` are ignored
parameters.help_zh: 任务明细ID列表，如果指定了该参数，则以该参数为准，BatchId和PhoneNumbers无效
parameters.name: detail_id_list

parameters.help_en: The batch ID. This ID is returned when you import callee data. You can find the task batch ID on the Call Task Management>Details>Execution Record page, or use the import batch ID that is returned by the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926815.html API operation. If DetailIdList is specified, this parameter is invalid
parameters.help_zh: 批次ID。即为导入被叫数据时返回的批次ID，在呼叫任务管理>详情>执行记录界面查看任务批次ID或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2926815.html接口导入被叫数据时返回的导入批次ID，如果指定了DetailIdList，则该参数无效
parameters.name: batch_id

parameters.help_en: A list of phone numbers. This parameter takes effect only when `BatchId` is also specified
parameters.help_zh: 手机号列表，如果需要使用该参数，则必须指定BatchId，否则认为参数无效
parameters.name: phone_numbers

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The detailed reason why the access was denied
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝的详细原因

FailedCount.description_en: The number of calls that could not be canceled

FailedDetails.description_en: Details about the failed cancellations. This is a map where the key is the failed detail ID or phone number, and the value is the reason for the failure
FailedDetails.description_zh: 失败明细情况。是个Map，Key为失败的明细ID或者手机号码，Value为失败原因

ResultCode.description_en:
The result code of the cancellation. Valid values:

ALL_FAILED: All cancellations failed.

ALL_SUCCEED: All cancellations succeeded.

PART_FAILED: Some cancellations failed
ResultCode.description_zh:
取消结果。取值：
ALL_FAILED：全部取消失败。
ALL_SUCCEED：全部取消成功。
PART_FAILED：部分取消失败

SucceedCount.description_en: The number of calls that were successfully canceled

Message.description_en: The message returned for the request

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request succeeded.

false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
